changelog: v0.6.2: Menu / session / traversal fixes. Pause, Resume and Quit to Menu now go through Main's state machine — quitting keeps the bootstrap scene, tears down mode/network/player nodes, stops the grapple loop, resets run state, and returns cursor/focus to a fresh menu, so a second match starts cleanly (previously the pause menu replaced Main and nothing could start another match). New industrial main menu: original backdrop + OFL font, PLAY opens a full-screen mode-card screen, then a mission-deployment screen (map, loadout, traversal editable before deployment; TD/Zombies keep their required maps and rules). Container-driven layout: scrolling + narrow-screen stacking replace overlapping panels; controller focus stays visible and returns to the originating screen. Wall-running: input projected onto the wall, contact tracked independently of camera yaw, tiny contact gaps bridged, high incoming speed preserved, forward wall-jump momentum kept, airborne chains to opposing walls allowed; same-wall reattachment blocked until landing or a different wall; entry boosts bounded. Grapple: angled shots apply radial pull while preserving tangential swing momentum; reeling works while attached incl. toggled input; close anchors release automatically. Resume hides the pause menu synchronously (no one-frame mouse-mode flip). Plus typed mode-list returns, optional Forge HUD scaling in non-Forge modes, and export-config placeholders fixed (credentials stay blank).
